executive_summary: Maven compilation failed due to a method signature mismatch in TaskManagementController. The controller is calling getUserTasks() with a Pageable parameter, but the TaskService interface expects two int parameters (page and size). This is a straightforward compilation error requiring interface alignment.

errors.message: Method getUserTasks cannot be applied: required (Long,int,int), found (Long,Pageable)
errors.root_cause: The TaskManagementController at line 50 calls taskService.getUserTasks() with parameters (Long userId, Pageable pageable), but the TaskService interface defines getUserTasks() expecting (Long userId, int page, int size). This signature mismatch causes compilation failure.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update TaskService.getUserTasks() method signature to accept Pageable instead of separate int parameters. Change the interface method from 'getUserTasks(Long userId, int page, int size)' to 'getUserTasks(Long userId, Pageable pageable)'. Then update the implementation class accordingly.
